title: The run screen grows from the overlay into a full-screen session, animated, and is driven from the keyboard
name: session-shell
description:
The frame, not the lines. As in `docs/design/watch-the-run.html`, in `apps/dashboard/src/logs/Logs.tsx` (and `Overlay.tsx` / `App.tsx` as needed):
- Keep opening as the wide overlay.
- A full-screen button and `f` switch to full screen with the springy morph: visible overshoot, the canvas blurs and darkens, and the title bar, transcript and status bar come in staggered, ~450 ms. Shrinking back mirrors it and is faster, with no overshoot. Animate transform/opacity/filter only. Reduced motion gets a 120 ms crossfade. The product follows the OS setting; the mockup's force-motion switch is for review only.
- Title bar: three dots that bounce in a Mexican wave whenever the run is live, in overlay and full screen (static under reduced motion or once the run ends), then `sober › <node name>`, then the model badge.
- Model badge: the provider logo in its brand colour, the provider name and the model id, with `via <host>` in dim text. The provider comes from the model id, not the host, so `anthropic/claude-…` on openrouter is still Anthropic. Put the provider map in `logs/data.ts` with a neutral fallback. Use real provider marks (e.g. from simple-icons, inlined as SVG paths), not the mockup's approximations. Brand colours come from the tokens transcript-adr adds.
- Keyboard: `f`; `Esc` leaves full screen first, then closes; `j`/`k` scroll; `g`/`G` go to top/bottom; `/` opens find, which filters lines.
- A `N new lines ↓` pill appears when the reader has scrolled up (reuse `atBottom`).
- Focus stays trapped and visible.
Tests go in `logs/Logs.test.tsx` and `logs/data.test.ts`, including the provider map.

brief.approach:
This node builds the frame, not the lines. Port it from the approved `docs/design/watch-the-run.html`, using the tokens from ADR 0064 in `apps/dashboard/src/theme.css`.

1. **Full screen state.** `Logs.tsx` (`LogScreen`) owns a `full` boolean. `Overlay.tsx` takes `full` and swaps its fixed 980px sizing for the whole viewport, keeping the same dialog markup (`role="dialog"`, `aria-modal`).
2. **Morph.** Run it in a `useLayoutEffect` with the Web Animations API, the same FLIP technique as the mockup's `toggleFull`:
   - Measure the box before and after the change, then animate `transform` and `opacity`.
   - Growing uses the spring `linear(0, 0.32 12%, 0.72 27%, 0.95 43%, 1.018 60%, 0.995 80%, 1)` over ~450 ms. The canvas behind blurs to about 5px and darkens. The title bar, transcript and status bar come in with a stagger (opacity + translateY 8px, 60 ms apart).
   - Shrinking mirrors this in ~330 ms with an ease-out curve and no overshoot.
   - Under `prefers-reduced-motion` it is a 120 ms crossfade. The product follows the OS setting. There is no force switch; that was mockup-only.
   - Cancel running animations when the toggle fires again quickly and when the component unmounts.
   - Put the durations and easing strings in `logs/data.ts` as constants.
3. **Title bar**, in this order:
   - Three dots that do the Mexican wave (staggered translateY keyframes) while `live === true`, in both overlay and full screen. They are static once the run ends or under reduced motion. Put the keyframes in `theme.css`.
   - `sober › <node>`.
   - The model badge.
4. **Model badge.** Add to `logs/data.ts`:
   - `modelOf(host)`: reads the model out of the host command line. It handles `--model X`, `--model=X` and `-m X`, and returns null when none is there.
   - `providerForModel(model)`: ports the mockup's regexes. `anthropic/` or `claude-` → Anthropic, `openai/` / `gpt-` / `o1|o3|o4` → OpenAI, `google/` / `gemini-` → Google, `mistralai/` / `mistral-` / `codestral-` → Mistral, anything else → other.
   Render:
   - the provider mark as inline JSX `<path>` elements (no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`), coloured with `var(--provider-*)`;
   - the provider name, then the model id in mono;
   - `via <host binary>` in dim ink.
   For the marks, take the path data from simple-icons (CC0), vendored as a constant with a source comment, wherever the icon exists there. Otherwise use the mockup's simplified mark. Add no new dependency. If there is no model, the badge shows the fallback mark and the host only. The data comes from `LogWindow.ran`.
5. **Keyboard**, handled on the dialog and ignored while a textarea or input has focus:
   - `f` toggles full screen.
   - `Esc` leaves full screen first, then closes. Stop propagation so `App.tsx`'s Escape does not fire twice.
   - `j`/`k` scroll 80px.
   - `g`/`G` go to the top/bottom.
   - `/` opens a find box that filters lines through a pure `matchesLine(line, query)` in `data.ts`. The filter checks `text`, `detail` and `tool`, which is null-safe because line-detail adds those fields.
6. **New-lines pill.** Show `N new lines ↓` when the reader has scrolled up. Reuse `atBottom` and count unseen lines. A click jumps to the bottom.
7. **Focus trap.** A small hand-written Tab / Shift+Tab trap inside the dialog, with no dependency. Focus stays visible.
8. **Scope.** Leave the transcript rows (tool-blocks) and the footer/status bar content (session-statusbar) alone. This node only adds the frame around them.

**Tests** go in `logs/data.test.ts` and `logs/Logs.test.tsx`:
- `modelOf` and `providerForModel` cases, including openrouter `anthropic/claude-…`, which must resolve to Anthropic;
- `matchesLine`;
- `f` toggles the full-screen state;
- Esc order;
- keys ignored in the textarea;
- the pill appears when scrolled up;
- the dots carry the wave class only while live.

acceptance.proves: provider and model mapping, find filtering, the keyboard, full-screen toggling, the pill and the dot wave behave, and nothing else in the dashboard broke
the theme still holds ADR 0039/0064: OKLCH only, all tokens present
provider marks are JSX, not injected HTML
